items.summary: Maintain a small launch pipeline: complicated.work (priority; scaffold with existing bounded readiness research), deadlymaracas.com (scaffold; readiness evidence required), and driveford.net (scaffold; readiness evidence required). Do not add domains, spend, deploy, or launch. Standard launch packet: site brief, reusable template, content seed, SEO baseline, analytics/affiliate readiness, compliance checklist, security review, named owner, measurement plan, and rollback gate. Strongest candidate is complicated.work because a bounded inspection already exists; its launch remains blocked by failed compliance checks, analytics not configured, and incomplete security/owner evidence. Exactly one next step: CTO/site-factory owner completes a read-only launch-readiness packet for complicated.work, recording the owner, intended scope, template/content seed, SEO baseline, analytics and affiliate prerequisites, legal/compliance findings, security unknowns, measurement acceptance criteria, and rollback boundary; keep it preview-only pending Legal, Security, measurement, and owner approval.

Complete one read-only launch-readiness packet for complicated.work. Do not implement, deploy, add tracking, add dependencies, spend, or change production. Acceptance requires explicit owner, legal/compliance, security, measurement, and rollback fields, with unknowns preserved and preview-only disposition recorded.
